It was rather frightful to watch it. All the animals, all living [ShA:] Bagoxoneta is an animals hid in their holes. Everyone left. The tale says that the black bear won.unexpected form. Normally, either bagoxoneda sg or bagixiuneta pl. Why then? This is why. The black bear has a lot of wool, its wool is thick. Strong blows of the white bear's claws did not hit him hard. Soft fur covered him. The white [ShA:] The syntax of the sentence is rather strange and completely unclear.bear has little fur. Its body is sometimes seen. The black bear beats his mate hard. The white bear became all wounded. One can see his blood. He became weak because of his wounds. He fell to the ground. He could not fight. So the black bear won. The bears went each to their own den.[ShA:] The form sÉnokuÄ is unexpected here.[ShA:] -xaÊ is a TE affix. They got tired, they had no strength. They had to think about how they live further. "We cannot live in the same place," - said the white bear. "I'll leave, I'll go far to the sea. Where the thick ice is, I will go there. And you live here. And you stay here in the forest. I am not afraid of water and cold. I like water, I'll go, brother." Since then, the white bear and the black bear have been living separately. They live in different places. One of them lives in the ice, the other walks in the forest.
